data.name: Yug
data.long_meaning: Yug is a Sanskrit term that refers to an age or a cycle in Hindu mythology. It is often used to describe the four major ages or cycles in Hinduism, namely the Satya Yug, Treta Yug, Dwapar Yug, and Kali Yug. Each yug is characterized by its moral and ethical values, and the current age, Kali Yug, is believed to be a time of darkness and moral decay, preceding the next age of light and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the cyclical nature of time and the universe.
